# Baseline questionnaire

The questionnaire administered at the baseline visit.

## Section 1: background

1. Year of birth
2. Highest completed education
3. Current living situation

## Section 2: habitual activity

| Item | Response options |
|:---|:---|
| Days per week with ≥30 min activity | 0–7 |
| Usual intensity | Light / moderate / vigorous |

: Habitual activity items. {#tbl-app-activity}

See @tbl-app-activity for the activity items.
